name: ARC
description: The AI2 Reasoning Challenge provides grade-school-level science questions split into an Easy set and a Challenge set. The Challenge set (2,590 questions) contains questions that simple retrieval and co-occurrence methods could not answer correctly, targeting models that can perform genuine multi-hop reasoning about elementary science concepts.
typical_sota_score: ~90–96% on Challenge set (approaching saturation for frontier models)
reputation: Widely used science reasoning benchmark from Allen Institute for AI; included in HuggingFace Open LLM Leaderboard v1; cited in hundreds of model papers; the Challenge set remains a standard open-source evaluation task
notes: The Easy set is trivially solved by all modern models. The Challenge set (ARC-C) still appears in evaluation suites but approaches saturation for frontier models. Remains relevant for evaluating smaller and open-source models. Questions sourced from standardized US science exams for grades 3–9.
